  • Method Details

    • stop

      void stop(@Nullable String errorType)
      Called when the operation ends. On a reactive server this runs on the thread delivering the result, completion, error or cancellation.
      Parameters:
      errorType - The type of the error that ended the operation, or null when it succeeded: McpServerObserver.TOOL_ERROR; the JSON-RPC error code, as a string, of the protocol error the operation ended with, so -32603 for an exception thrown by a prompt, resource or completion method unless an McpErrorExceptionMapper maps it to another code, or McpServerObserver.OTHER_ERROR for a code outside the range JSON-RPC reserves; McpServerObserver.CANCELLED; or the fully qualified class name of an Error the method threw, for example java.lang.StackOverflowError. An Error that reaches the server through a returned publisher or future, or that a method declaring @ExecuteOn throws on the synchronous server, is handled like an exception.
